court: Delhi District Court (Commercial Courts-05, South), Saket
summary: A sole-proprietor digital marketing business (social media, content, graphic design, website updates and SEO) sued the company over two unpaid invoices from April and May 2022. The court decreed Rs 4,87,900 with 8% interest and costs against the company and one of its directors, jointly. It found the 18% interest claimed too high and dismissed the claim against a second director. Appeal status was not checked.
